businesses.business: irrigation equipment and road safety infrastructure

offering_description.value: Manufactures center pivot and lateral move irrigation systems, related technology and controls for agricultural producers, plus road safety products such as crash cushions and guardrail end terminals for highway contractors and transportation agencies. Also does infrastructure project work. Products are made in company plants and sold mainly through dealers and contractors.

primary_products.value: center pivot irrigation systems; lateral move irrigation systems; irrigation control and water management technology; highway crash cushions and barriers; guardrail end terminals

primary_services.value: infrastructure construction projects; road safety equipment installation; remote irrigation monitoring and management

customer_segment.value: B2B: farmers, growers, irrigation dealers, highway contractors, municipal and industrial water users; B2G: state departments of transportation and road authorities

end_markets.value: agriculture; highway and road infrastructure; water management; transportation

revenue_model.value: product sales: irrigation systems, replacement parts and road safety products; project or contract: infrastructure projects, including road safety and water-related work; subscription: digital irrigation monitoring and control services
revenue_model.category: product sales; project or contract; subscription

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: fabricates irrigation systems and road safety products from steel and components, sold to dealers, contractors and agencies

geography_served.value: global: United States, Brazil, South Africa, Europe, Middle East, Asia, Australia and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: irrigation equipment and technology, road safety products and infrastructure services

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent irrigation dealers serving farmers; direct sales: road safety products to contractors and transportation agencies, large project customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: road safety products need crash-test approval under FHWA and state DOT standards, environmental and trade rules apply
